title: Core: Implement Git change detection
description:
## What I did

Added Git change detection for the ChangeDetectionService so that whenever a new commit is created or the branch is switched, the module graph will be reevaluated. In practice, this means that as soon as file changes are committed, components will no longer be marked "modified".

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Change detection now watches git repository state and automatically rescans (debounced) when refs/HEAD change; detects intent-to-add files so new files are reported correctly.
  * Service can run with change detection disabled and reports readiness as unavailable when so configured.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved watcher lifecycle, reuse and teardown to avoid stray watchers and ensure cleanup on service dispose.
  * More robust handling of worktree/HEAD transitions and watcher errors.

* **Tests**
  * Expanded tests covering git-state subscriptions, debounce behavior, watcher semantics and unsubscribe safety.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

human_comments.body: onGitStateChange() kicks off ensureWatchers() without awaiting it. If a consumer unsubscribes before setupWatchers() finishes, the cleanup runs before watchers exist and the in-flight setup can still create watchers afterward, leaving open FSWatchers with zero callbacks registered. Consider tying cleanup to watcherSetupInFlight (e.g., when the last callback unsubscribes, await/finally the in-flight setup then clearAllWatchers) or re-check callback count immediately before/after each watcher is created.
